cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: One Last Thing
cards.instruction: Keep someone present by discovering one more small task, question, or favor whenever departure seems near.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Before you go, could you check this window latch?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Then why's the curtain moving?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you show me which switch? There are several.

mechanism: A turns the departing pupil successful checks into evidence it is ready for one more practical lesson.
confusable: Unlike a fixed long lesson, each new small demand is discovered at the moment the last would permit departure.
comparison: Household fault-check examination versus etiquette lessons exploiting a waiting taxi.
